ch.hero.label: Rank correlation between the two channels
ch.hero.range: {n} countries: {one} exposed on one channel only, {both} on both, {none} on neither
ch.hero.text.neg: Those exposed on one channel tend not to be exposed on the other: {a} countries combine many sight deposits with little dollar funding, {c} the reverse.
ch.hero.text.pos: Those exposed on one channel tend to be exposed on the other as well: the two risks add up rather than offset each other.
ch.hero.text.none: There is no clear relation between the two channels: exposure on one says little about exposure on the other.
